environment.briefing: 涨水只变成浅水，不把已知必经道路突然变成深水；火区在上一轮预告。失控机器电击按各自预告。

fire_pulse.rule: 预告点火后，所列格持续3次环境结算，各1伤害；浅水电伤与火同格取较大值，不双扣。不可燃的墙/深水不点燃。

backup.deadline_rule: 从简报和第1轮即明示。玩家在该轮仍可操作，轮末未secured则lost；已完成复制/交付永久保留。携带但未交付不算完成，不可事后补领奖。该计时不随接近触发，不因难度临时隐改。
backup.label: 保存广播备份
backup.opportunity_reason: 第3轮末临时备份缓冲被轮换覆盖，提前拷贝可保留地方记录
backup.secured_rule: completed milestone receipt; rescue/cargo requires delivered, channel requires full hold, convoy requires final waypoint

broadcast.label: 持续发出通告
broadcast.secured_rule: completed milestone receipt; rescue/cargo requires delivered, channel requires full hold, convoy requires final waypoint

relay.label: 解除广播干扰
relay.secured_rule: completed milestone receipt; rescue/cargo requires delivered, channel requires full hold, convoy requires final waypoint
